finding.title: Split 6 story-acceptance test files that exceed the 400-line AG-3 cap

evidence.quote: /// Story acceptance tests for Epic 25 — Schema + Core Foundation. (2036 lines total)
/// Story acceptance tests for Epic 25 — Story 25.12 (DNI-333): (718 lines total)
/// Story acceptance tests for Epic 25 / Story 25.16 (DNI-337): (564 lines total)
/// Story acceptance tests for Epic 25 — Story 25.13 (DNI-334): (501 lines total)
/// Story acceptance tests for Story 25.20 (DNI-341) — MaterialApp locale (449 lines total)
/// Story acceptance tests for Epic 25 — Story 25.18 (DNI-339): (402 lines total)

finding.why: AG-3's own enforcement command (`find lib test -name '*.dart' ... | xargs wc -l | awk '$1>400'`) explicitly covers test/. Content past a file's length is outside typical per-file agent read budgets and the file becomes a dumping ground for unrelated concerns — epic_25_schema_core_test.dart is 5x over the cap at 2036 lines and bundles 8 unrelated stories (25.3, 25.5, 25.7, 25.8, 25.10, 25.11, 25.17, 25.19) under one non-story-numbered slug, unlike all 12 sibling epic_25 files which are one-file-per-story.
finding.recommendation: Split epic_25_schema_core_test.dart along its existing per-story group() boundaries into epic_25_story_{3,5,7,8,10,11,17,19}_*_test.dart to match the one-file-per-story convention already used everywhere else in this batch; trim story_12/13/16/18/25_20 by extracting large fixture/fake blocks (e.g. the FirestoreGateway fakes) into test/helpers/.
acceptance_criteria: `find learning_tracker/test learning_tracker/lib -name '*.dart' ! -name '*.g.dart' ! -name '*.freezed.dart' | xargs wc -l | awk '$1>400'` no longer lists any of these 6 files
each split-out file keeps its @Tags(['epic_25']) and story tag, and `make test-story-25.<N>` still passes for each story

finding.title: Deduplicate the two full 40-method FirestoreGateway fakes in epic_25_story_12_sync_decomp_part1_test.dart

evidence.quote: // W6.13: fetchAuditLogEntries added to FirestoreGateway interface.

finding.why: _RecordingGateway (lines 242-467) and _PagingGateway (lines 475-697) each hand-implement all 40 FirestoreGateway methods with near-identical no-op bodies. The file's own retrofit comments ('W6.13: fetchAuditLogEntries added...', 'T1.gateway — parent-scoped child reads (stub)') appear in both classes, proving every past interface addition already had to be pasted into both by hand; the identical pattern repeats in 20+ other test files repo-wide (test/sync/*, test/core/sync/*), so the next FirestoreGateway method is N-way shotgun surgery, and a forgotten override silently returns a stale default in one fake but not the other.
finding.recommendation: Extract a shared `NoOpFirestoreGateway` base (all 40 methods returning empty/no-op defaults) into test/helpers/ or test/mocks/; have _RecordingGateway/_PagingGateway extend it and override only the handful of methods each test actually exercises.
acceptance_criteria: _RecordingGateway and _PagingGateway shrink to only their overridden methods plus the shared base
adding a new FirestoreGateway method requires editing the shared base once, not every fake in this file

finding.title: Replace the tautological AuthRepository mock-shape test in epic_25_schema_core_test.dart with real coverage or delete it
finding.why: The test stubs every AuthRepository member on a mocktail Mock and then asserts the mock returns exactly what it was just told to return — it can never fail regardless of what AuthRepositoryImpl actually does, so it gives false confidence that Story 25.11's 'sole firebase_auth consumer' AC is under test. Real behavioural coverage already exists separately in test/features/auth/data/repositories/auth_repository_impl_test.dart, so today this test adds zero net verification while reading like acceptance coverage for the story.
finding.recommendation: Delete the runtime expect() calls and keep this as a documented compile-only shape check (a referenced-but-uncalled function is enough to prove the interface compiles), or point the docstring at auth_repository_impl_test.dart so reviewers don't mistake mock-echo assertions for behavioural coverage.
acceptance_criteria: test either exercises AuthRepositoryImpl directly or is reduced to a compile-time shape check with no expect() calls that only echo their own stubs

finding.title: Fix the two-call wall-clock race in epic_25_schema_core_test.dart's SystemLocalDayClock.today() test
finding.why: clock.today() and DateTime.now() are two independent wall-clock reads compared for equal year/month/day; if local midnight falls between the two calls the assertions intermittently disagree — a hairline but real flake source, exactly the class TQ-6 exists to keep out of test/ (test/ is not yet covered by the DateTime.now() audit grep that already protects lib/).
finding.recommendation: Capture one DateTime.now() first and derive both the expected y/m/d and the clock.today() call from it, or bracket clock.today() between a before/after DateTime.now() pair instead of comparing to a second independent read.
acceptance_criteria: test reads the wall clock once (or brackets before/after) instead of comparing two independent DateTime.now()-derived values

finding.title: Consolidate the ad hoc MaterialApp test-wrap helpers in story_21 and story_25_9 into a shared pumpApp

evidence.quote: Widget wrap({required AuthState authState, required Widget child}) =>

finding.why: No shared, reviewed pumpApp helper exists yet (TQ-3 is still [Pending] repo-wide); each file hand-rolls its own MaterialApp wrapper and the two disagree on localization wiring — story_21's wrap() sets localizationsDelegates/supportedLocales but story_25_9's _wrap() sets neither. It only works today because the CurriculumLabel widgets under test in story_25_9 don't call AppLocalizations.of(context); the first future test added to that harness that does will throw MissingLocalizationsDelegate with no forcing function that would have caught it earlier.
finding.recommendation: Add test/helpers/pump_app.dart with one canonical ProviderScope + MaterialApp(localizationsDelegates:, supportedLocales:) wrapper taking overrides + child, and migrate both local helpers onto it.
acceptance_criteria: test/helpers/pump_app.dart exists and both files call it instead of their local wrap/_wrap
a widget added to epic_25_story_25_9_test.dart that calls AppLocalizations.of(context) resolves without a missing-delegate error
